name: 王聖銘
objective: This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, interactive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and practice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of interaction design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the profession of interaction design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct multi-disciplines learning environment which performs a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate on an interactive media design project. It may execute interaction design by working with the form of the case study or design creation.
課程進度(1-16週):
Design studio helps to develop students’ research abilities to identify problems, envision current and future needs, and provide validated solutions to these problems and needs through interaction design.
1. Project-based Learning I Taiwan Design Week Observation and Evaluation	
2. Term Project and Paper with Tangible MVP 
3. Outcome-Based Education (OBE) learning report
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 參與校內外活動 (講座、工作坊、參訪) 或競賽 (Participation in on-campus or off-campus activities (lectures, workshops, visits) or competitions)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          We will arrange a 6-hour flexible learning period during Weeks 17-18 for students to visit the "Taiwan Design Week" exhibition, with the theme "HCI and UI/UX in Design Week: Interactive Experience Fieldwork and Cross-Disciplinary Redesign." 
The primary goal is to serve as an ideal entry point for grounding theoretical knowledge in practical observation and integrating both "design thinking" and "technical implementation," within a flipped classroom framework.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          From the perspective of a cross-disciplinary HCI x UI/UX Designer, students are required to deliver the following integrated outcomes:
1. HCI Exhibition Experience Diagnostic Report" (PDF/Slide)
2. Technology & Experience Deconstruction
3. User Behavior Observation Records 
4. HCI x UI/UX Technology & User Experience Evaluation Report Writing
5. 3-Minute Demonstration Video
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          The field trip and practical module account for 20% of the final grade. Assessment emphasizes "theoretical connections," "depth of field observation," and "feasibility of HCI technical improvements."
1. Pre-exhibition Preparation & Observation Scale Design (15%)
2. Exhibition Diagnostic & In-Depth Analysis Report (35%)
3. HCI x UI/UX Redesign Implementation & Prototype Demonstration (35%)
4. Peer Review & On-site Presentation (15%)

name: 陳圳卿

name: 黃儀婷
objective: The goal of this course is to explore research topics related to interactive design and interactive media. Through intensive discussions and project-based research and practice, students can effectively exchange ideas, gain deeper and broader experiences, and develop research, analytical, and practical skills. Another key learning objective is to construct a multidisciplinary interactive learning environment. Using a project-oriented learning model, graduate students with expertise in design, art, and information technology will collaborate to complete research and creation projects on interactive media design. Teaching will primarily consist of lectures, field observations, and project-based learning, with assessment methods including reports, group discussions and presentations, and completed projects.
